start: Body screen, Weight chip, History list with own entries

steps.action: Tap one of your own weigh-ins
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Fix this weigh-in' with the value, 'Day' row and Save, Delete
must_not: A gym-recorded entry opening for edit

steps.action: Change the value to 81.4 and tap Save
user_sees: Sheet closes; the list and chart show 81.4 on that day
must_not: Value saved in the wrong unit (kg vs lb)
Sheet closing when the save failed

steps.action: Clear the value (or type 0) and tap Save
user_sees: 'Type a number above 0, like 82.5.'
must_not: The entry saved as 0 or empty

steps.action: Type 820 (a typo) and tap Save
user_sees: A question about the unlikely jump with 'Keep it' and 'Fix it'
must_not: The typo saved without asking

steps.action: Look at an entry your gym recorded
user_sees: History says 'Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: A Delete button on the gym's entry

steps.action: Tap Delete
user_sees: Sheet closes; an Undo bar 'Weigh-in on <day> deleted'
must_not: An 'Are you sure?' box
The entry still in the list

steps.action: Tap Undo
user_sees: The weigh-in is back with its day and value
must_not: Undo failing with no word (the undo error is swallowed)

steps.action: Edit another entry and move it to a day that already has one; tap Replace
user_sees: Undo bar 'Replaced the entry on <day>'; Undo brings both back
must_not: Two weigh-ins on one day
The replaced entry lost for good

steps.action: Tap a day on the chart that has your own entry
user_sees: The same fix sheet opens for that day's entry
must_not: A sheet for a day with no entry
